meta.name: Neighborhood District
meta.axes: x east, z north, y up, origin at map center
meta.symmetry: Compact street blocks around a central park. Maple House is the first fully detailed building; unfinished buildings are neutral blockouts until approved.

rules: Compact low-poly suburban tactical map using a tighter 88m x 88m playable footprint.
Maple House is the first approved architectural prototype with a pitched roof; other buildings remain neutral blockouts for staged development.
Keep the central park, market lane, bus stop, parking, and side routes traversable.
Building interiors, stairs, collisions and roof/balcony access require runtime validation before further buildings are approved.
Team spawn markers remain at opposite ends; they are layout markers, not a networked multiplayer implementation.
